roleInfo.sweeperKeeper: Comes far off his line and builds play with short passes.

roleInfo.wideMidfielder: Works up and down the flank.
roleInfo.winger: Takes on his man down the line and crosses.
roleInfo.invertedWinger: Cuts inside looking for a shot or a through ball.
roleInfo.attackingMidfielder: Creative behind the strikers and a goal threat.
roleInfo.shadowStriker: Bursts from midfield into the box.
roleInfo.insideForward: Comes inside from the flank and finishes.
roleInfo.advancedForward: Runs in behind and lives off his finishing.
roleInfo.targetMan: Holds the ball up, wins headers and lays it off.
roleInfo.poacher: Lurks in the box for that one chance.
roleInfo.deepLyingForward: Drops deep and links up with team-mates.

press.q.b.streakLoss2: Are you already feeling the pressure from the board?

building.smallStadium: Small stadium for youth, women and reserves
event.nightclub.title: Night out
event.nightclub.text: {1} was photographed in a nightclub in {5} at 4 a.m. — two days before the match. The pictures are already online.
event.speeding.title: Caught speeding
event.speeding.text: {1} was caught doing 180 km/h in a built-up area. The licence is gone and the tabloids are delighted.
event.wantsOut.opt.promise: Promise a move in the summer
event.wantsOut.opt.raise: Keep them with a pay rise
event.wantsOut.title: {1} wants out
event.wantsOut.text: {1} lets it be known via their agent that a move to a bigger club is the goal. The fans are alarmed.
event.birthdayParty.title: Birthday party
event.birthdayParty.text: {1} invites the whole squad to a birthday party. Midweek.
event.tattoo.title: New tattoo
event.tattoo.text: {1} has had the club crest tattooed on their back — unfortunately with a spelling mistake.
event.trainingFight.title: Training ground fight
event.trainingFight.text: {1} clashed with a teammate in training. Punches were thrown.
event.lateTraining.title: Late for training
event.lateTraining.text: {1} was late for training for the third time this week. Excuse: "traffic".
event.charityGala.title: Charity gala
event.charityGala.text: {1} is invited to a charity gala in {5}. Lots of press, little sleep.
event.fanVisit.title: Hospital visit
event.fanVisit.text: {1} visited children in hospital in {5}. The photos move the whole city.
event.socialMediaRant.title: Social media rant
event.socialMediaRant.text: {1} complained about their playing time on social media. Thousands of likes.
event.sickNote.title: Flu
event.sickNote.text: {1} has caught the flu and will miss a few days of training.
event.weightGain.title: Too many kilos
event.weightGain.text: {1} has come back from holiday five kilos overweight.
event.homesick.opt.mentor: Assign a mentor from the squad
event.homesick.opt.nothing: They'll have to get through it
event.homesick.title: Homesick
event.homesick.text: {1} misses home. Their training performances are noticeably dropping.
event.languageCourse.title: Language course?
event.languageCourse.text: {1} only understands half of the instructions in the dressing room. A language course would help.
event.talentOffer.opt.publicize: Happy to put them in the spotlight
event.talentOffer.title: Hype around a talent
event.talentOffer.text: A major sports magazine wants to run a cover story on {1}.
event.modelContract.title: Modelling contract
event.modelContract.text: {1} has an offer for an underwear campaign. The shoot lasts three days.
event.playerBook.title: Autobiography
event.playerBook.text: {1} is publishing an autobiography. One chapter contains spicy dressing-room details.
event.injuryHousehold.title: Household accident
event.injuryHousehold.text: {1} was injured assembling flat-pack furniture and will be out for a few days.
event.injuryPet.title: Bitten by the dog
event.injuryPet.text: {1} was bitten in the calf by their own dachshund. Out for a while.
event.injurySerious.title: Injured in kickabout
event.injurySerious.text: {1} got injured in a kickabout with friends. Their contract actually forbids it.
event.religiousFast.title: Fasting period
event.religiousFast.text: {1} is fasting for religious reasons in the coming weeks and asks for consideration in training.
event.captainTalk.title: Captain asks for a talk
event.captainTalk.text: {1} speaks on behalf of the squad: training is too hard and the mood is suffering.
event.doping.title: Positive test?
event.doping.text: A banned substance in cough syrup was found in {1}'s sample after a cold. The FA imposes a provisional ban.
event.secondJob.title: Second job
event.secondJob.text: {1} wants to work part-time at a garage in {5} to make ends meet.
event.studies.title: University course
event.studies.text: {1} wants to start a distance-learning degree. Some exams fall on matchdays.
event.keeperGloves.title: Lucky gloves lost
event.keeperGloves.text: {1} has lost their lucky gloves and has been completely unsettled since.
event.strikerDrought.title: Goal drought
event.strikerDrought.text: {1} hasn't scored for weeks. In training they even miss an empty net.
event.defenderGaffe.title: Blunder
event.defenderGaffe.text: {1} decided the last match with a mistake. The internet shows no mercy.
event.retirementThoughts.title: Retirement?
event.retirementThoughts.text: {1} is openly thinking about retiring. The knees just won't cooperate any more.
event.hairstyle.title: New hairstyle
event.hairstyle.text: {1} turns up to training with a pink mohawk. Teammates have been laughing for hours.
event.gamingAddiction.opt.esports: Let them play an esports event for the club
event.gamingAddiction.title: Nights on the console
event.gamingAddiction.text: {1} games until late into the night and yawns non-stop in training.
event.politicalStatement.title: Controversial interview
event.politicalStatement.text: {1} commented on a political issue in an interview. Reactions are pouring in.
event.contractDemand.title: Pay demand
event.contractDemand.text: {1}'s agent demands a pay adjustment — supposedly there are offers from abroad.
event.fanFight.title: Row with fans
event.fanFight.text: {1} got into a loud argument with fans at the fence after the match.
event.extraTraining.title: Hard worker
event.extraTraining.text: {1} asks for extra sessions with the assistant — an hour longer every day.
event.weddingPlans.title: Wedding
event.weddingPlans.text: {1} is getting married in the summer and would love the squad to attend.
event.babyBorn.title: New arrival!
event.babyBorn.text: {1} has become a parent. The squad is already planning a thumb-sucking celebration.
event.agentPoach.title: Agent circling
event.agentPoach.text: A notorious agent is courting {1} and promising big money.
event.injuryComeback.title: Speed up the comeback?
event.injuryComeback.text: The doctors say {1} could return earlier — at a risk.
event.miracleHealer.title: Miracle healer
event.miracleHealer.text: A healer from {5} promises to get {1} fit in a week with horse liniment and crystals.
event.anniversary.title: Club anniversary
event.anniversary.text: {0} celebrates a milestone anniversary. The members expect a party.
event.legendVisit.opt.welcome: Lap of honour in the stadium

event.mayorVisit.title: Mayor's visit
event.mayorVisit.text: The mayor of {5} wants to visit training — in the middle of an election campaign.
event.cityGrant.title: City grant
event.cityGrant.text: The city of {5} supports {0}'s youth work with a grant of {2}.
event.taxAudit.title: Tax audit
event.taxAudit.text: The tax office objects to travel expense claims. They demand {2}.
event.insuranceClaim.title: Insurance pays out
event.insuranceClaim.text: The insurer reimburses old water damage in the clubhouse: {2}.
event.busBreakdown.title: Bus breakdown
event.busBreakdown.text: The team bus has broken down on the motorway. The final training session is in danger.
event.hotelFire.title: Hotel fire alarm
event.hotelFire.text: At 3 a.m. the fire alarm went off at the team hotel. A fan of the opponents is suspected.
event.clubhouseBurglary.title: Clubhouse burglary
event.clubhouseBurglary.text: Persons unknown have raided the trophy cabinet in the clubhouse.

event.kitClash.text: The kit supplier delivered the away shirts in the wrong size. All XS.
event.mascotScandal.title: Mascot brawl
event.mascotScandal.text: The club mascot got into a fight with {3}'s mascot at half-time.
event.songContest.title: New club anthem?
event.songContest.text: A local band from {5} offers to record a new anthem for {0}.
event.documentary.title: Documentary series
event.documentary.text: A streaming service wants to film behind the scenes at {0} for a whole season. Fee: {2}.
event.youthTournament.title: Youth tournament
event.youthTournament.text: {0} is asked to host an international youth tournament.
event.friendlyInvite.title: Friendly offer
event.friendlyInvite.text: {3} offer a lucrative friendly. Appearance fee: {2}.
event.formerPlayerDies.title: Mourning a club great
event.formerPlayerDies.text: {0}'s long-serving honorary captain has passed away. The city is in mourning.

event.strikeTrains.text: The rail workers are on strike. Travel to the next away game must be re-planned.

event.vipComplaints.text: Box guests complain about cold canapés and lukewarm sparkling wine.
event.boardMemberScandal.title: Board scandal
event.boardMemberScandal.text: A board member allegedly used club money for private trips.
event.investorInterest.title: Investor knocking
event.investorInterest.text: An overseas investor wants to buy into {0}. The fans are up in arms.
event.lotteryWin.title: Raffle luck
event.lotteryWin.text: The club wins the raffle at the {5} town festival. Top prize: {2}.
event.cleaningLady.opt.raise: Pay rise for the soul of the club

event.cleaningLady.text: The kit manager celebrates 40 years of service. The players want to do something nice for her.

event.rivalPoachScout.text: {3} want to poach your best youth scout.
event.matchFixingRumour.title: Betting rumours
event.matchFixingRumour.text: A bookmaker reports suspicious bets on a {0} match.

event.teamBuilding.text: The assistant suggests a team-building day.

event.karaokeNight.text: After the win, the squad want to go to a karaoke bar. Videos are guaranteed.
event.chefQuit.title: Chef quits
event.chefQuit.text: The team chef has resigned. Tomorrow it's sausages and chips.
event.wifiOutage.title: Wi-fi outage
event.wifiOutage.text: The wi-fi at the training centre is down. Some players seem lost.

event.fanClubFounded.text: A new fan club has been founded in {5}. The members would love you to visit.

event.pyro.text: Flares were lit on the terraces at the last game. The FA imposes a fine of {2}.

event.fanBanner.text: A banner hangs on the terraces: "Board out!" The press asks for your opinion.

event.fanTravel.text: The fan liaison officer asks whether the club will subsidise buses for the next away trip.

event.fanPetition.text: Over 5,000 fans have signed a petition demanding the return of the old kit colours.

event.fanFestival.text: The fans would like a big party to open the season.

event.ultraFight.text: Fans of {0} and {3} clashed outside the stadium. The police are investigating.

event.fanChoreoMoney.text: The ultras ask for a contribution towards a huge choreography.

event.fanAnniversary.text: The oldest fan club is celebrating 50 years. Members hope the squad will visit.

event.ticketScalping.text: Tickets for the big game are being sold online at ten times face value.

event.photoScandal.text: A photo shows {4} having dinner with the president of {3}. What's being discussed?

event.refereeCriticism.text: Emotions are running high after the last game: the referee denied two clear penalties.
event.statsNerd.title: Data analysis
event.statsNerd.text: A stats blog has analysed {0} in detail. The author is looking for a job.
event.expertPundit.title: Pundit sneers
event.expertPundit.text: A TV pundit says {4} "has no clue about modern football".
event.fairPlayAward.title: Fair play award
event.fairPlayAward.text: {0} receives the FA's fair play award and a prize of {2}.
event.sponsorScandal.title: Sponsor under fire
event.sponsorScandal.text: One of {0}'s perimeter sponsors is in the headlines for pollution.

event.sponsorParty.text: The main sponsor expects five players at its company anniversary — two days before the match.
event.sponsorBonusCampaign.title: Special bonus
event.sponsorBonusCampaign.text: A sponsor spontaneously pays a special bonus of {2} after the win.
event.merchRecord.title: Merchandise record
event.merchRecord.text: The club shop reports record sales. Extra income: {2}.

event.merchFlop.text: The new club garden gnomes aren't selling at all. The warehouse is full.

event.printingError.text: The opponent's name is misspelled on 10,000 matchday programmes.

event.energyBill.text: The back payment for floodlights and undersoil heating is {2}.

event.lawsuit.text: A former player is suing {0} for outstanding bonuses.
event.donation.title: Generous donation

event.bankFees.title: Bank fees
event.bankFees.text: The bank raises its fees because of the low balance.

event.cateringContract.text: A large caterer wants to take over the stadium and offers {2} more per season.

event.ticketSystem.text: The ticket system has crashed. Hundreds of fans were left outside locked gates.
event.crowdfunding.title: Crowdfunding
event.crowdfunding.text: The fans suggest a crowdfunding campaign for a new scoreboard.
event.betSponsor.title: Betting partner

event.auctionShirt.title: Shirt auction
event.auctionShirt.text: The shirt from the last match is auctioned. Proceeds: {2}.

event.pitchMoles.text: Moles have dug up the pitch at {6}.

event.pitchFrost.text: Severe frost threatens the pitch. The groundsman asks for covers.

event.pitchConcert.text: A global star wants to perform at {6}. Rent: {2}. The pitch will suffer.
event.floodlightFail.title: Floodlight failure
event.floodlightFail.text: The floodlights failed for ten minutes during the last evening game. The repair costs {2}.
event.roofLeak.title: Leaking roof
event.roofLeak.text: The stand roof is leaking. Water is dripping onto the VIP guests in the main stand.
event.stormDamage.title: Storm damage
event.stormDamage.text: A storm has destroyed parts of the scoreboard and several advertising boards.

event.heatWave.text: 38 degrees in the shade. The pitch is burning, and so are the fans.
event.flooding.title: Flooding
event.flooding.text: After continuous rain, the training ground is under water.
event.neighbourComplaint.title: Residents' complaint
event.neighbourComplaint.text: Residents complain about noise from evening training under floodlights.
event.historicFind.title: Building site find
event.historicFind.text: During building work, the ball from {0}'s first ever competitive match was found.
event.seatVandalism.title: Vandalism
event.seatVandalism.text: After the last match, 200 seats were ripped out in the away section.
event.parkingChaos.title: Parking chaos
event.parkingChaos.text: There is traffic chaos around {6} on matchdays.
event.pitchInvasion.title: Streaker
event.pitchInvasion.text: A streaker in a mascot costume interrupted the last match for five minutes.
event.groundsmanGenius.title: Pitch of the year
event.groundsmanGenius.text: The groundsman has turned the pitch into a work of art. He would like more money.
event.bombScare.title: Suspicious object
event.bombScare.text: An unattended suitcase in the stadium led to an evacuation. It was a forgotten picnic hamper.
event.snowClearing.opt.volunteers: Call on fans to clear the snow
event.snowClearing.title: Snow chaos
event.snowClearing.text: Half a metre of snow has fallen overnight. The weekend match is at risk.
event.rivalTrashTalk.title: Trash talk
event.rivalTrashTalk.text: The manager of {3} has called {0} a "yo-yo club".
event.refereeAssigned.title: Jinx referee
event.refereeAssigned.text: The next match will be refereed by the very official against whom {0} have not won in ten years.
event.youthGem.title: Youth gem
event.youthGem.text: The youth coach raves about a 15-year-old who plays "like a young world star".
event.trainingInjuries.title: Injury wave
event.trainingInjuries.text: The doctors warn that training is too intense and muscle injuries are piling up.
event.opponentSpy.title: Spy at the fence
event.opponentSpy.text: A man with binoculars was spotted at the training ground — supposedly a scout from {3}.
event.legendCoachAdvice.title: Advice from the honorary president
event.legendCoachAdvice.text: The honorary president has suggestions for the line-up — on a napkin.
event.superstition.title: Superstition
event.superstition.text: The squad insist that you wear the same jumper until the next defeat.
event.militaryCamp.title: Army boot camp
event.militaryCamp.text: A fitness guru recommends three days of army drill.
event.tacticsBoardBroken.title: Tactics board broken
event.tacticsBoardBroken.text: The tactics board broke during a passionate half-time team talk.
event.nationalTeamCall.title: National team
event.nationalTeamCall.text: {1} has received a first call-up to the national team.
event.rivalBuysStar.title: The rival strengthens
event.rivalBuysStar.text: {3} have signed a top star. The fans ask when {0} will follow suit.
event.lostLuggage.title: Lost luggage
event.lostLuggage.text: The airline has lost the kit bags. The match is tomorrow.
event.assistantOffer.opt.keep: Keep them with a higher wage
event.assistantOffer.title: Assistant courted
event.assistantOffer.text: {3} want to appoint your assistant as their head coach.
event.fitnessTest.title: Fitness test
event.fitnessTest.text: Pre-season starts with the fitness test. Some players have been lazy on holiday.
event.winterBreakTrip.title: Winter break
event.winterBreakTrip.text: The players hope for a training camp somewhere warm.
event.womensTeam.title: Women's football
event.womensTeam.text: The city of {5} and several sponsors support the founding of a women's team at {0}.
event.goatMascot.title: Goat mascot
event.goatMascot.text: A farmer from {5} gives the club a goat. It has already eaten Hans-Dieter — the ball.
event.ufo.title: UFO over the stadium
event.ufo.text: Several fans claim to have seen a UFO over {6}. It was the advertising blimp.
event.wrongAnthem.title: Wrong anthem
event.wrongAnthem.text: The stadium announcer accidentally played {3}'s anthem before the match.
event.psychic.title: Psychic
event.psychic.text: A psychic offers to predict the opponent's penalty takers.
event.octopus.title: Oracle octopus
event.octopus.text: The aquarium in {5} has an octopus predicting {0}'s matches. So far it's always been right.
event.lookalike.title: Lookalike
event.lookalike.text: A man from {5} looks exactly like {4} and is already signing autographs.
event.streetNamed.title: Street named
event.streetNamed.text: The city of {5} names a street near the stadium after {0}.
event.cakeDisaster.title: Cake in the face
event.cakeDisaster.text: At the president's birthday party, the cake accidentally landed in your face.
event.seagulls.title: Seagull plague
event.seagulls.text: Hundreds of seagulls have discovered the stadium as a resting place. The training jackets suffer.
event.mysteryFan.title: The most loyal fan
event.mysteryFan.text: A 92-year-old fan hasn't missed a home game since 1951.
event.wrongBus.title: Wrong bus
event.wrongBus.text: The team bus drove to {3}'s stadium — the match is somewhere else.
event.ghostStadium.title: Ghost in the dressing room
event.ghostStadium.text: The kit man swears he hears voices in the dressing room at night. The players won't shower alone any more.
event.sausageRecord.title: Sausage record
event.sausageRecord.text: More sausages were sold at {6} last match than ever before. Extra profit: {2}.
event.managerDance.title: Dance routine
event.managerDance.text: After the win, the fans demand that {4} dances in front of the terrace.
event.pigeonRace.title: Pigeon club
event.pigeonRace.text: The local pigeon racing club wants to name a pigeon after {0}.
event.wrongTransfer.title: Fax mishap
event.wrongTransfer.text: The office accidentally faxed an offer for {3}'s kit manager.
event.vegetarianMenu.title: Diet change
event.vegetarianMenu.text: The nutritionist demands a vegetarian menu. The dressing room is horrified.
event.ballboyHero.title: Hero on the touchline
event.ballboyHero.text: A ball boy set up a goal at the last match with a lightning-quick throw.
event.pressFlirt.title: Fan mail from abroad
event.pressFlirt.text: A fan club from Japan has discovered {0} as their favourite club and wants to attend the next home game.
event.rivalPrank.title: Rival prank
event.rivalPrank.text: {3} fans painted the goals at {6} in their club colours overnight.
event.weatherPray.title: Weather prayer
event.weatherPray.text: The groundsman prays for good weather every morning. So far, successfully.
event.selfieFine.title: Goal celebration selfie
event.selfieFine.text: {1} took a selfie with a fan's phone while celebrating a goal. Yellow card.
board.requestHelp: Each request can only be made every 60 days. The board decides based on confidence and finances.
build.chooseBuilding: Choose a building for this plot. Larger buildings occupy several plots to the right and below.
